label: Automotive Venue
description: Car-specific places: showrooms, garages, test facilities and the pilgrimage roads and circuits of car culture.

items.name: dealership-showroom
items.text: Inside a flagship dealership showroom, mirror-gloss porcelain tile, floor-to-ceiling curtain glass and slender spotlit display plinths under recessed track lighting.

items.name: wind-tunnel
items.text: Inside an aeroacoustic wind tunnel on the rolling-road balance, a smoke-wand streamline tracing clean laminar flow over the static body toward the great turbine grille.

items.name: robotic-integration-bay
items.text: A sterile vehicle integration bay, epoxy-white floors gridded with alignment markings, orange robotic arms poised over the line under shadowless panel lighting.

items.name: underground-hypercar-garage
items.text: An exclusive minimalist underground hypercar garage, with walls of obsidian-like polished stone and concrete, lit by sharp architectural light strips in the floor and ceiling.

items.name: deserted-racetrack
items.text: A deserted racetrack under stark floodlights, rubber marbles swept off the racing line, empty grandstand rows climbing behind the catch fencing and a silent, shuttered pit lane.

items.name: modena-road
items.text: A sun-warmed provincial road outside Modena, poplar and cypress rows between terracotta farmhouses, Lambrusco vines strung on wires along the flat Emilian verge.

items.name: roman-piazza
items.text: A Roman piazza paved in fanned sampietrini setts, a travertine fountain at its centre and baroque facades in burnt sienna and ochre washed by warm lamplight.

items.name: munich-street
items.text: A clean Munich boulevard, Wilhelminian stucco facades and linden rows flanking wide lanes, the twin copper domes of the Frauenkirche on the skyline.

items.name: black-forest-road
items.text: A sweeping Black Forest B-road, dense firs breaking for a valley view at the apex.

items.name: monaco-tunnel
items.text: The curved harbor tunnel at Monaco, amber sodium light strobing across ribbed concrete walls toward the bright arch opening onto the sea.

items.name: goodwood-paddock
items.text: A festival hillclimb paddock, hay bales, white marquee tents and priceless machinery parked in casual rows on trodden grass.

items.name: alpine-pass-hairpins
items.text: A high alpine pass road stacked with hairpins, stone guard walls and thin bright air.

items.name: amalfi-corniche
items.text: A cliff-hugging Amalfi corniche, pastel villages tumbling to a glittering sea below the guardrail.

items.name: villa-deste-lawn
items.text: The terraced concours lawn of a grand Lake Como hotel, raked gravel walks and umbrella pines stepping down to the mosaic waterfront, mist softening the far shore behind the rope lines.

items.name: maranello-gates
items.text: The historic factory gates of Maranello, ochre walls and the archway of the old entrance framing decades of scarlet legend.

items.name: fiorano-circuit
items.text: The private Fiorano test circuit, worn apex curbs, telemetry masts and a lone timing hut beside the pit exit.

items.name: mugello-circuit
items.text: The Mugello circuit flowing through a Tuscan hill amphitheater, red-and-white curbs rising and falling with the terrain.

items.name: monza-banking
items.text: The abandoned historic Monza banking, moss-streaked concrete wall of speed curving away between the pines.

items.name: sant-agata-gates
items.text: The flat Emilian road past Sant'Agata's factory gates, poplar rows and hexagon-patterned architecture behind the fence.

items.name: targa-florio-village
items.text: A Sicilian mountain village street of the old Targa Florio route, faded racing paint on stone walls and tight balconied corners.

items.name: stuttgart-zuffenhausen
items.text: The cobbled works yard of Zuffenhausen, brick factory halls and the museum's floating monolith beyond the gate.

items.name: weissach-proving
items.text: A development-centre proving ground near Weissach, painted calibration circles, cone gates and low camera rigs on tripods.

items.name: bmw-welt-plaza
items.text: The sweeping plaza before BMW Welt in Munich, double-cone glass architecture spiraling beside the four-cylinder tower.

items.name: bavarian-alpenstrasse
items.text: A sweep of the German Alpine Road in Bavaria, flower meadows, an onion-dome chapel and limestone peaks over the guardrail.

items.name: affalterbach-works
items.text: The performance works of Affalterbach, black-clad engineering halls and a row of camouflaged prototypes across the lot.

items.name: nurburgring-karussell
items.text: The banked concrete plates of the Karussell, graffiti-painted curbing wrapped by dark Eifel pines.

items.name: autobahn-sweep
items.text: A derestricted autobahn sweep, immaculate tarmac, blue distance boards and the round de-restriction sign blurring past.

items.name: woking-mtc-lake
items.text: The curved glass facade of a Woking technology centre reflected in its formal lake, manicured berms rolling to the water.

items.name: cotswold-lane
items.text: A Cotswold village lane between honey-stone cottages and dry-stone walls, hedgerow England at its most cinematic.

items.name: brooklands-banking
items.text: The surviving concrete banking at Brooklands, weeds threading the expansion joints as the Members' Banking rears above the trees and ends mid-air where the old circuit was severed.

items.name: le-mans-mulsanne
items.text: The endless tree-lined Mulsanne straight, rumble strips, marshal posts and kilometer boards shrinking to a vanishing point.

items.name: col-de-turini
items.text: The stacked hairpins of Col de Turini, stone kilometer markers and rock walls scarred by rally history.

items.name: molsheim-chateau
items.text: A raked gravel château forecourt in Molsheim, clipped hedges and wrought-iron gates worthy of coachbuilt royalty.

items.name: angelholm-runway
items.text: A Swedish airfield runway at Ängelholm, hangar doors open behind painted threshold stripes and a long heat-shimmered centreline.

items.name: hakone-turnpike
items.text: The Hakone Turnpike sweeping up through cedar forest toward the Daikanzan crest, the cone of Mount Fuji rising beyond Lake Ashi.

items.name: wangan-expressway
items.text: The elevated Bayshore expressway over Tokyo harbor, lane markers strobing past gantries and container cranes.

items.name: shuto-c1-loop
items.text: The tight elevated curves of Tokyo's inner C1 loop, sound-barrier walls skimming past the guardrail, illuminated office towers stacked close enough to touch beyond the expressway lamps.

items.name: daikoku-parking
items.text: The looping ramps above Daikoku parking area, concrete pillars and painted bays under the elevated interchange.

items.name: suzuka-esses
items.text: The flowing esses of Suzuka, blue-and-white curbs threading between grandstands and the ferris wheel on the skyline.

items.name: fuji-straight
items.text: The kilometer-long main straight of Fuji Speedway, pit buildings on one side and Mount Fuji filling the horizon.

items.name: irohazaka-switchbacks
items.text: The one-way Irohazaka switchbacks at Nikkō, numbered hairpins signed with kana characters climbing through dense maple forest.

items.name: woodward-avenue
items.text: Wide lanes of Woodward Avenue, drive-in signage, brick storefronts and the boulevard heritage of American muscle.

items.name: cars-and-coffee
items.text: A cars-and-coffee meet filling a shopping-plaza lot, folding chairs behind open trunks, paper cups resting on fenders and phone photographers crouched at every bumper.

items.name: laguna-seca-corkscrew
items.text: The crest of the Corkscrew at Laguna Seca, curbing dropping away into dusty golden hills and scrub oak.

items.name: mulholland-overlook
items.text: A Mulholland Drive overlook, canyon guardrail and the endless grid of Los Angeles spread out far below.

items.name: pebble-beach-lawn
items.text: The concours lawn at Pebble Beach, clipped fairway grass running to wind-bent Monterey cypress above the Pacific, rope lines and judges' ribbons between entrants.

items.name: pikes-peak-summit
items.text: The upper switchbacks of Pikes Peak above the treeline, red gravel shoulders and no guardrail between the tarmac and a mile of blue air.

items.name: bonneville-salt-course
items.text: The Bonneville salt course, blinding white crust running to the curve of the horizon, the black guide line and mile-marker flags dissolving into mirage.

items.name: tail-of-the-dragon
items.text: A tree-tunneled Appalachian pass road of relentless linked curves, double-yellow centreline snaking through green shade with no straight in sight.

items.name: transfagarasan-ramps
items.text: The northern ramps of the Transfăgărășan, switchbacks stacked up a glacial valley wall with the full route visible winding kilometers below.

items.name: furka-pass
items.text: The Furka Pass hairpins, the shuttered Belvédère hotel wedged into its famous curve, scree slopes and glacier ice hanging above the valley.

items.name: grossglockner-road
items.text: The Grossglockner High Alpine Road, smooth tar sweeping between numbered granite kilometer pillars and snow poles, the cobbled Edelweissspitze spur corkscrewing above the treeline.

items.name: spa-eau-rouge
items.text: The Eau Rouge-Raidillon compression at Spa, the track plunging then hurling itself uphill between pine banks and painted curbs.

items.name: nardo-ring
items.text: The Nardò high-speed ring, a perfect 12.6-kilometer circle of banked lanes cutting through Puglian olive groves.

items.name: ehra-lessien-straight
items.text: The hidden proving straight at Ehra-Lessien, nearly nine kilometers of dead-flat concrete walled in by pine forest, a vanishing point that never arrives.

items.name: drag-strip
items.text: A prepared drag strip, rubber-darkened launch pads behind the burnout box, the Christmas-tree light gantry and quarter-mile boards down the lane.

items.name: barn-find
items.text: A dusty timber barn interior, shafts of light through gapped plank walls, straw drifts, an oil-stained workbench and enamel signs in the gloom.

items.name: pit-lane
items.text: A modern circuit pit lane, painted working bays, air hoses coiled by the wall and gantry lights over the boxes.

items.name: start-finish-grid
items.text: The start-finish grid of a grand prix circuit, painted grid slots, rubbered-in tire marks and the lights gantry overhead.
